preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 668.
Length of the permutation is between 2 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation is between 1 and n.
All elements in the permutation are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output permutation has the same length as the input permutation.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_prime_i <= n for p_prime_i in p_prime)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output permutation is between 1 and n.
All elements in the output permutation are distinct.
The output permutation is different from the input permutation.

postconditions.expression: sorted([p[i] + p[i+1] for i in range(n-1)]) == sorted([p_prime[i] + p_prime[i+1] for i in range(n-1)])
postconditions.description: The fingerprint of the output permutation is the same as the fingerprint of the input permutation.
